text:
```yaml
name: PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  brin-security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Brin security scan
        id: brin-scan
        run: npx @brin/security-scan --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --token ${{ secrets.BRIN_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update PR comment with scan results
        if: success() || failure()
        run: |
          echo "::add-comment::### Brin Security Scan Results"
          echo "::add-comment::${{ steps.brin-scan.outputs.summary }}"

      - name: Remove PR comment on clean PR
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "::remove-comment::### Brin Security Scan Results"

      - name: Fail check on dangerous commits
        if: failure()
        run: exit 1
```
